scenario:
A leading global e-commerce platform is developing a comprehensive Order Management System to efficiently handle and analyze customer orders, shipping logistics, and product management. The platform serves millions of customers worldwide, offering a vast array of products across multiple categories, and supports various sales channels, including web and mobile applications.

The system needs to manage detailed order information, including customer profiles, order histories, product details, shipping options, and promotional activities. It must track orders from placement to delivery, providing real-time updates on shipping status and handling potential issues such as fraud detection and VIP customer priorities.

Additionally, the platform requires a robust analytics component to analyze purchasing trends, customer behavior, and product performance. The system should support complex promotional mechanisms, dynamic pricing strategies, and personalized marketing campaigns. With diverse users, including resellers and VIP customers, it must incorporate flexible user roles and permissions for managing access to sensitive data.

To ensure scalability and reliability, the system should maintain strong data integrity through well-defined relationships between orders, products, users, and shipping details. It must also track the use of promotional codes, manage inventory levels, and provide insights into product origins and categories.
